records.finding: New edge-table row asserted a CLI to incident-adapter hand-off that does not exist. cmd/shortfall/go.mod requires no adapters/incident/* module and main.go dispatches only version/validate/impact/reconcile; the CLI renders to stdout via engine/report. Incident adapters take an engine.Report value directly (slack.Client.Post/.Refresh), wired by the reader's own program. The CLI --> INC arrow encoded the same false dependency.
records.evidence: Claim: '| engine -> cmd/shortfall -> incident adapter | The CLI composes the report and hands it to an incident adapter to post and refresh |' — contradicted by cmd/shortfall/go.mod and cmd/shortfall/main.go:31-51.
records.reason: Arrow replaced with ENGINE -->|engine.Report| INC; the row split into two true rows; a key fact added stating the CLI is not a router. Re-review verdict: addressed.

records.finding: New edge-table row claimed one Compute() call fans out to coverage. engine.Compute never calls engine.Coverage; it assigns a hard-coded unavailable CoverageLeg because engine.Coverage needs a provider ledger an impact Request does not carry.
records.evidence: engine/engine.go:195-201 'report.Coverage = CoverageLeg{Evidence: EvidenceTrust, Unavailable: "coverage needs a provider ledger — run shortfall reconcile for the trust number"}'; engine/coverage.go:38 takes ledger []biz.LedgerRow; only non-test caller is cmd/shortfall/reconcile.go:79.
records.reason: Coverage removed from the Compute() fan-out and hung off the report on a dotted reconcile-time edge; subgraph retitled to name both entry points; node label, two table rows and a key fact rewritten. Re-review verdict: addressed.

records.finding: New edge-table row named an edge 'queue carriers -> propagate/httpmw' with no counterpart in code. propagate/httpmw imports no carrier package and propagate/kafka|sqs|amqp import no httpmw; they are sibling seams. A consumer calls propagate.Extract and puts the ValueContext on its own ctx.
records.evidence: propagate/httpmw/httpmw.go imports only log/slog, net/http, strings, otel/baggage, biz, registry; propagate/kafka/kafka.go imports only github.com/NightWatchEng/shortfall/propagate; propagate/carrier.go:49 func Extract(c Carrier).
records.reason: Arrow re-pointed from MW to EMIT with the label 'biz.vc off the message -> ctx'; row rewritten to name propagate.Extract and the sibling-seam relationship explicitly. Re-review verdict: addressed.

STYLE.md picks that exact case as its worked example of a defect and offered no class for a whole-product box.

The worked example is qualified 'at Level 2', the optin row is scoped 'Level 2 down', the checklist item reads 'true at this diagram's level of zoom', and L1's prose says the box is the whole system in scope. records.finding: Raised by the scoped re-review against the repair itself: the dotted edge label 'shortfall reconcile only' asserted the coverage leg flows into the Report under reconcile. cmd/shortfall/reconcile.go calls engine.Coverage and passes the leg straight to renderCoverage, never constructing an engine.Report.
records.evidence: cmd/shortfall/reconcile.go:79-86 then :109 renderCoverage(stdout, leg, slices); the only non-test assignment to Report.Coverage is engine/engine.go:198, always the unavailable stub.
records.reason: Edge relabelled 'a field on the Report; a real number only from reconcile'; the row and key fact now say the reconcile-time number is rendered on its own and never flows back into a Report.

records.finding: Raised by the scoped re-review against the repair itself: the new row listed the CLI's verbs as validate/impact/reconcile, omitting the version/--version case main.go also dispatches.

records.finding: Alleged that the validate-to-de-dup row wrongly places registry legality of flow/stage and segment-enum membership inside validation.
records.evidence: Reviewer cited emit/emitter.go:358-382 flowStageLabels/segmentLabel as the real enforcement point.
records.reason: Refuted by the cross-examiner (sole arbiter). The row never says 'registry-legal', and every item it names is in fact checked by Outcome.Validate: amount via Money.Validate, flow/stage/segment via lowerToken (biz/context.go:102,155), PII via biz.CheckPII over EntityID/CustomerID/Source/Err. The same fence's LABELS node and the adjacent row already assign registry-enum membership and the 'unregistered' fallback to label enforcement, so the diagram already draws the split the finding says is missing.

records.finding: Alleged that 'A drop increments biz_dropped_events_total{reason}; it is never silent' on the emit-to-exporter edge overstates coverage, because metric-point drops are logged but not counted.
records.evidence: Reviewer cited emit/emitter.go:298-299 warn-only paths and Record's doc comment.
records.reason: Refuted by the cross-examiner (sole arbiter). The counter is event-scoped by name and its antecedent in the same sentence is 'unsampled outcome events'; for events the claim is exact (emit/emitter.go:289 dropCounts[export] += len(events)). Metric drops are warned at :264 and :299 and the deltas are re-credited at :303-307, so nothing is silent there either. Decisively, the unqualified contract already stands untouched on main at emit/emit.go:65 ('drop with a visible counter, never silently') and docs/semconv.md:50; the diagram row agrees with the repo's standing statement rather than contradicting it. Any residual tension is a pre-existing one between emit/emit.go:65 and Record's doc comment, which this diff does not touch.

records.finding: Alleged that STYLE.md section 4's unconditional 'Every diagram file carries these' contradicts the Scope paragraph's exemption for the not-yet-redrawn seq-*.md files, and that README.md repeats the absolute form.
records.evidence: Reviewer cited STYLE.md:157 vs STYLE.md:14-16 and README.md:12, plus the absence of edge tables and key-facts sections in the three seq-*.md files.
records.reason: Refuted by the cross-examiner (sole arbiter). Section 4 states the requirement; Scope states, in the present tense and two sentences away, which files already meet it ('The three C4 diagrams are drawn to it today. The money-path sequences are governed by it but have not been redrawn yet'). README.md's paragraph carries the same qualification in its closing sentence. A standard plus an explicitly declared gap is the normal shape of one, not two disagreeing wordings. The seq-*.md files are out of scope for this item by design (tracked separately as workspace-qmw).
